title: Motocentric Rear Bag 37 L – The Helmet Fits in the Bag
descriptionHtml:
The helmet dangles from the handlebars or stays home

Anyone who rides knows: the helmet doesn't fit anywhere once you've parked, and the backpack can't hold both it and the rain gear.

The rear bag that swallows the whole helmet

A 37-liter rear bag from Motocentric that straps onto the seat or the luggage rack. The helmet goes in, the rain gear and gloves fit beside it, and the reflective details show in the dark.

Features

  • The helmet finally gets a place – 37 liters swallow it with room to spare
  • Stays put on the bike – straps for the seat or luggage rack
  • Carried as a backpack off the bike – shoulder straps and a ventilated mesh back panel
  • Visible in the dark – reflective details on the back
  • Packs more than the helmet – rain gear, gloves and a chain lock fit beside it

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
